title: Geometry-anchored spatial event encoder zero-training readiness
purpose: Prove that a pose-free polar encoder can express every frozen C01-C08 terminal/junction Teacher token inside current LiDAR support before any joint training.

approval.scope: One immutable zero-training C01-C08 input/interface/support/readiness proof; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner access.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.independent_sampling_unit: World, directed traversal and objective structure-event identity.
sampling.temporal_context: Current organized LiDAR plus exactly four causal predecessor frames; no future frames.
sampling.rule: Audit every Teacher row/token once; use one deterministic real row for each cardinality 0-5 for forward/backward readiness.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 five-frame organized LiDAR sequences at one-metre arc spacing.
source.student_input: Only five referenced range_m[16,720] and valid_mask[16,720] frames.
source.teacher_labels: Variable terminal/junction type, robot-relative xyz, padding mask and teacher-only identity.

split.strict_test: C10 and M-TARE unread; C09 quarantined and unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: A preparatory file search exposed only field names/shapes from one historical C09 archive; no values or statistics enter this audit. Formal inputs bind only C01-C08 and record zero C09/C10/M-TARE reads.
split.checkpoint_selection: None; zero training and no checkpoints.

teacher.valid_mask: Teacher event_mask; zero-event rows retained and padding inactive.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Readiness emits robot-relative provisional event tokens only; later graph edges remain execution-verified and no Teacher identity is available online.
teacher.leakage_controls: Teacher identity and all world/route/pose fields are used only for audit joins, never passed to the encoder.

methods.main: Circular 180-bin encoder over five organized scans with explicit elevation projections; query coordinates are bounded by attention-weighted current free-range support.
methods.baseline: The sealed frozen encoder plus unconstrained event decoder failed selection F1 and typed-query coverage.
methods.fallback: If any Teacher token lacks LiDAR support or interface/equivariance/set loss fails, stop before training and revise only the encoder representation contract.

acceptance.population: Exactly 80 worlds, 188126 unique observations, 133055 tokens, 1076 identities and frozen type/cardinality counts.
acceptance.support: Every Teacher event distance is within its current organized-LiDAR polar-cell free-range support.
acceptance.interface: Only range/valid inputs; exact 264134 parameters; deterministic finite cardinality 0-5 set loss/backward; query permutation loss <=1e-6; 18-degree rotation xyz error <=1mm; all predicted ranges bounded by free-range anchors.
acceptance.system: Zero optimization, trained inference, threshold selection, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph and planner access; source hashes unchanged.

estimated_cost.compute: Sequential CPU read of each C01-C08 current organized scan plus four random-initialized six-row forwards and one backward.

failure_policy: Any count/join/input/support/equivariance/determinism/gradient/source-integrity defect fails closed; do not alter Teacher, data, bins or acceptance thresholds inside the run.
retention: Retain summary, support audit, logs, environment, config, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
